consensus_summary: Eight non-ranking concerns are retained in immutable source order. EIC finding 1 is independently corroborated by R2 finding 2 and DA Major 1; R1 finding 1 is corroborated by DA Major 2. Those overlaps are shared evidence-and-remedy operations, not a claim of statistically independent consensus. The remaining concerns are single-seat findings, and the DA reports no Critical item.
dissenting_opinions: The methodology seat treats the stored matrix-level negative evidence as sufficient for its declared finite scope, while the DA requires either a primitive loxodromic owner witness or explicit confinement to matrix compression; the roadmap adopts the confinement remedy unless new owner evidence is separately produced.

The domain seat accepts the proved level-subgroup conjugacy scope, while the DA identifies ambiguity about whether ambient Bianchi conjugacy belongs to the intended owner quotient; the roadmap requires an explicit owner-group choice without presuming a new ambient invariant.

The methodology seat commends the honest two-of-three control disclosure, while the DA regards the missing operational specification as preventing closure; the roadmap preserves exploratory status and requires the open control obligation to be defined.
